<div style="margin-bottom:100px;">

# Paradigm

Simultaneous color working memory paradigm with set size three. Items are presented at the same time for 1,000ms, and are at least 30 degrees apart in color space. 2 AFC with 180 degrees apart foil is presented afterwards. There are two conditions: real world intact objects vs. scrambled object images. Before the trial begins, participants are given 4 digits to verbally repeat as they do the task. At the end of the trial, they're asked to report those four digits. Verbal task accuracy is analyzed separately, and anyone with lower than  80% accuracy was excluded from the further color memory performance analyses.
<br>
<br>
Participants who have overall d' of under 0.5 will be excluded as well as trials with RTs lower than 200ms or higher than 5000ms will also be excluded. Participants who have more than their 10% of their overall trials excluded will be entirely excluded from the analysis.

Note: *all error bars are within-subject SEM*. Performance is plotted overall. 

</div>

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
#Set global variables
folder_name = "Experiment 3" #folder to load data from

dp.cutoff = 0.5          #d prime cutoff for exclusion based upon overall performance
```

#### Analyzing Data from <strong><u>`r folder_name`</strong></u>

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
#Load your participants!
file_names = list.files(paste0(path,'/',folder_name), pattern = ".txt")
subjects = c(1:length(file_names))
num_subjects = length(subjects)

#check
if (length(file_names)<10) {
  print('ERROR: Please check the data path')
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
setwd(path)

#Load the data and put in appropriate structures.
VWM_Data = data.frame();
Survey_Data = data.frame();
full_digits_response = c();
full_digits_answer = c();

for (i in 1:num_subjects){
  #load the data
  data = fromJSON(paste0(folder_name, "/", file_names[i]))
  correct = data$correct$values;
  
  rt = data$rt$values[4:(length(data$rt$values)-1)];
  rt = rt[-ceiling(length(rt)/2)]
  rt_select = seq(2,length(rt),by=3)
  rt = rt[rt_select]
  
  digits_answer = data$digits_answer
  digits_response = data$survey$values[1:length(rt)]
  
  trialType = data$trialType;
  corrLoc = data$corrLoc;
  key_response = data$key_response$values;
  
  full_digits_response = c(full_digits_response, digits_response)
  
  full_digits_answer = c(full_digits_answer, digits_answer)
  
  full_data = cbind(trialType, rt, correct, corrLoc, key_response)
  full_data = cbind(SubID = rep(i, nrow(full_data)), trialType, rt, correct, corrLoc, key_response)
  
  #attach it
  VWM_Data = rbind(VWM_Data, full_data);
  
  #Survey data
  loadsurvey = data$survey$values[length(data$survey$values)]; #only the last one since all the verbal task inputs are also "surveys"
  
  curSurvey = cbind(SubID = rep(i), loadsurvey);
  Survey_Data = rbind(Survey_Data, curSurvey)
}

Survey_Data$SubID = as.factor(Survey_Data$SubID)
VWM_Data$SubID = as.factor(VWM_Data$SubID)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
#This is to calculate the digits task accuracy
full_digits_numeric = substr(full_digits_response, 12, 15) #only the first four digits in response
digit_index = 1
digits_accuracy = c()

for (k in 1:length(full_digits_response)){
digits_numeric_eachTrial = as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(full_digits_numeric),"")[[k]])
digits_answer_eachTrial = full_digits_answer[digit_index:(digit_index+3)]

digits_check = c();
  for (m in 1:4){
    digits_check[m] = digits_numeric_eachTrial[m] %in% digits_answer_eachTrial
  }

if (all(digits_check) == TRUE) {
  digits_accuracy[k] = 1
} else {
  digits_accuracy[k] = 0
}

#check if there was a duplicate. if so, mark it wrong.
check_for_duplicate = duplicated(digits_numeric_eachTrial)
if (any(check_for_duplicate) == TRUE){
  digits_accuracy[k] = 0
}

digit_index = digit_index + 4
}

full_digits_accuracy = cbind(VWM_Data, digits_accuracy)
full_digits_accuracy_plot = full_digits_accuracy %>%
  group_by(SubID) %>%
  summarize(dig_acc = mean(digits_accuracy))

VWM_Data = cbind(VWM_Data, digits_accuracy)

digit_Plot = ggplot(data = full_digits_accuracy_plot, mapping = aes(x = SubID, y = dig_acc))+
  geom_col()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = .8, color = 'red', alpha = .5)+
  theme_linedraw()+
  labs(title = 'Digits Task Performance', x = 'Participant ID', y = 'Accuracy')

digit_Plot
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
#Count how many trials are missing data for each subject
VWM_Data %>%
  group_by(SubID) %>%
  summarize(num_missing = sum(is.na(rt)))

#Now exclude those trials with data missing
VWM_Data = na.exclude(VWM_Data)
```

<div style="margin-bottom:100px;">

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
## Get all the measures for plotting data ----------------------

#Take out trials with rt<200ms or rt>5000ms
outlier.RT_high = 5000;
outlier.RT_low = 200;
VWM_Data = filter(VWM_Data, rt > outlier.RT_low)
VWM_Data = filter(VWM_Data, rt < outlier.RT_high)

#Get hit and fa info in each lag and old/new condition
VWM.plot.data = VWM_Data %>% 
  group_by(trialType, SubID) %>%
  dplyr:: summarize(
    
            mean.RT = mean(rt), 
            
            n.trials = n(),
            hits = sum(correct == 1),
            fas = sum(correct == 0),
            hit.rate = sum(correct == 1) / n(),
            fa.rate = sum(correct == 0) / n(),
            dig_acc = mean(digits_accuracy)
            )

VWM.plot.data = data.frame(VWM.plot.data)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
## Plot overall d' ----------------------

#find overall d' for each subject
full.VWM.d.prime = VWM_Data %>% 
  group_by(SubID) %>%
  summarize(
            n.trials = n(),
            hits = sum(correct == 1),
            fas = sum(correct == 0),
            hit.rate = sum(correct == 1) / n(),
            fa.rate = sum(correct == 0) / n())

full.VWM.d.prime$dig_acc = full_digits_accuracy_plot$dig_acc

#find and track on overall d'
sj_dps = c();
for(k in 1:nrow(full.VWM.d.prime)){
  sj_dps[k] = dprime.mAFC(full.VWM.d.prime$hit.rate[k], 2)
}

full.VWM.d.prime = cbind(full.VWM.d.prime, dp = sj_dps)
full.VWM.d.prime$SubID <- as.factor(full.VWM.d.prime$SubID)

#Plot overall d'
dp_Plot = ggplot(data = full.VWM.d.prime, mapping = aes(x = SubID, y = dp))+
  geom_col()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, color = 'red', alpha = .5)+
  theme_linedraw()+
  labs(title = 'Overall Memory Task Performance', x = 'Participant ID', y = 'd\'')

dp_Plot
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
## Exclude based upon overall d' then number of trials then verbal task acc----------------------

#take out participants who had more than 10% of all trials taken out for outlier RTs
trial.count = VWM.plot.data %>%
  group_by(SubID) %>%
  summarize(remaining.trials = sum(n.trials))

#filter out participants with too few trials from RT cut offs and then with too low d'
enough.trials = filter(trial.count, remaining.trials > trial.cutoff)
sj.dps.enough.trials = filter(full.VWM.d.prime, SubID %in% enough.trials$SubID)
survive.exclusion = filter(sj.dps.enough.trials, dp > dp.cutoff)
survive.digit = filter(survive.exclusion, dig_acc > 0.8)

VWM_Data = filter(VWM_Data, as.factor(SubID) %in% survive.digit$SubID)
VWM.plot.data = filter(VWM.plot.data, as.factor(SubID) %in% survive.digit$SubID)

#find number of remaining participants
num_goodSJs = nrow(survive.digit) #number of participants who had less than 10% of trials excluded for too long RTs
print(num_goodSJs)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
## Adjust perfect hit rates and false alarm rates, then find average d's and RTs ----------------------
## This step is required in case there is a hit rate of 1 or false alarm rate of 0 in any conditions. However, in this data there was none, therefore this did not change any data.

#adjust perfect hit rates by pretending as if they would have gotten 1 trial incorrect in twice as many trials
for(k in 1:nrow(VWM.plot.data)){

  #for overall hit rate
  if (VWM.plot.data$hit.rate[k] == 1){
    VWM.plot.data$hit.rate[k] = VWM.plot.data$hit.rate[k] - (1/(VWM.plot.data$n.trials[k]*2))
  }

}

#adjust 0% hit rates by pretending as if they would have gotten 1 trial correct in twice as many trials
for(k in 1:nrow(VWM.plot.data)){

  #for overall hit rate
  if (VWM.plot.data$hit.rate[k] == 0){
    VWM.plot.data$hit.rate[k] = VWM.plot.data$hit.rate[k] + (1/(VWM.plot.data$n.trials[k]*2))
  }
  
}

#calculate d' for each condition and subject
target.dp = c();

for(k in 1:nrow(VWM.plot.data)){
target.dp[k] = dprime.mAFC(VWM.plot.data$hit.rate[k], 2) 
}

#put d' valus in VWM.plot.data
dps = cbind(target.dp) #, V1.dp, V2.dp, V3.dp, V4.dp)
VWM.plot.data = data.frame(VWM.plot.data, dps)

#Get within-subject accuracy standard error info in each lag and old/new condition
target.accuracy.SEM <- summarySEwithin(VWM.plot.data,
            measurevar = "target.dp",
            withinvars = c("trialType"), 
            idvar = "SubID",
            na.rm = FALSE,
            conf.interval = 0.95)

#Get within-subject RT standard error info in each lag and old/new condition 
SEM.RT.data <- VWM.plot.data %>% 
  group_by(SubID, trialType) %>%
  summarize(mean.RT = mean(mean.RT))

target.RT.SEM <- summarySEwithin(SEM.RT.data,
            measurevar = "mean.RT",
            withinvars = c("trialType"), 
            idvar = "SubID")
```

# VWM Task d' (N = `r num_goodSJs`) after exclusion
*Total (N = `r num_subjects`)

#### Target d prime
d' value for VWM 2AFC target judgment based upon trial types: 1 for intact real-world objects, 2 for scrambled objects. Error bars are within-subject SEM.
```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE} 
#Collapse down data to allow for plotting
Acc.plot.data = VWM.plot.data %>%
  group_by(trialType) %>%
  summarize(mean.dp = mean(target.dp))

Acc.plot.data$trialType = as.factor(Acc.plot.data$trialType)

Acc_Plot = ggplot()+
  geom_point(data = Acc.plot.data, mapping = aes(x = trialType, y = mean.dp))+
  geom_errorbar(data = target.accuracy.SEM, aes(x = trialType, ymin = target.dp - se, ymax = target.dp + se), width=0.1, size=.5)+
  theme_linedraw()+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set1")+
  labs(title = 'Target d\' by trial type', x = 'Trial Type', y = 'd\'')+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("real-world object", "scrambled object"))+
  theme(legend.position = c(.1,.85))

Acc_Plot
```

# Statistics

#### d' t test
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
## Do stats -----------------------------
Acc.STATS.data = VWM.plot.data %>%
  group_by(SubID, trialType) %>%
  summarize(mean.dp = mean(target.dp))

Acc.STATS.data$trialType = as.factor(Acc.STATS.data$trialType)

t.test(Acc.STATS.data$mean.dp~Acc.STATS.data$trialType, paired=TRUE)
cohen.d(Acc.STATS.data$mean.dp, Acc.STATS.data$trialType, pooled = TRUE, paired=TRUE)
```
